cues.en: In this lecture, I'm going to show you something called tool calling middleware.
cues.zh: 這堂課要介紹工具呼叫中介軟體，也就是 Tool Calling Middleware。

cues.en: And for that, I've taken a copy of the creating tools, the first tool video we saw, where we had three different tools for
cues.zh: 我複製了第一段建立工具的範例，裡面有三個工具，分別用來

cues.en: getting person, getting person, and change colour.
cues.zh: 取得所有人員、取得特定人員，以及改變顏色。

cues.en: And what I have done over in this version is I have removed these information printouts
cues.zh: 在這個版本裡，我把原本顯示工具正在呼叫的

cues.en: that tools are being called, because that is too cumbersome to do.
cues.zh: 輸出訊息移除了，因為每個工具都加一次太麻煩。

cues.en: We have middleware to do that for us.
cues.zh: 可以改用中介軟體統一處理。

cues.en: And middleware is a method called middleware, or whatever you call it, you can choose.
cues.zh: 中介軟體是一個方法，這裡叫 Middleware，你也可以自行命名。

cues.en: And it takes an input of the agent that are using the middleware, or about to do the tool call, context about the tool
cues.zh: 它接收目前使用中介軟體、即將進行工具呼叫的代理程式，以及這次工具

cues.en: call, and next objects.
cues.zh: 呼叫的 Context 和 Next。

cues.en: If you know middleware, you normally invoke these if you want to proceed, and not invoke it if you don't, and then some cancellations.
cues.zh: 如果熟悉中介軟體，就知道要繼續執行就呼叫 Next，不要繼續就不呼叫，另外還有取消權杖。

cues.en: We can set a breakpoint in this.
cues.zh: 可以在這裡設中斷點。

cues.en: In order to enable this middleware, we have changed our agent slightly, and that we have set as builder on the agent, use middleware
cues.zh: 要啟用這個中介軟體，代理程式的建立方式稍微改一下，呼叫 AsBuilder、Use，然後

cues.en: .build. If we do this, the agent goes from a chat client agent to an AI agent, which is a more generic agent.
cues.zh: Build。這樣原本的 ChatClientAgent 會變成比較通用的 AIAgent。

cues.en: This has some negative effects later on, but for now, it doesn't matter for us.
cues.zh: 這對後面的內容有一些影響，但目前沒有關係。

cues.en: And the negative thing is that structured output becomes a bit more cumbersome to do, so it's not a total loss, but it is
cues.zh: 其中一個影響是結構化輸出的做法會稍微麻煩一點，不是不能做，只是

cues.en: a little annoying that it changes.
cues.zh: 型別改變會有點不方便。

cues.en: But if we do this, we can now run, and we can ask about the different
cues.zh: 現在就可以執行，詢問不同人員

cues.en: people's colours.
cues.zh: 喜歡的顏色。

cues.en: So if we ask about Mona's favourite colour, we hit this breakpoint, so we get that
cues.zh: 例如問 Mona 最喜歡什麼顏色，就會停在這個中斷點。

cues.en: we have an agent, and we get some context about what we are about to call here.
cues.zh: 可以看到目前的代理程式，以及即將呼叫工具的相關 Context。

cues.en: In this case, it's the tool called getPerson, and the argument is this case, as we
cues.zh: 這次工具名稱是 getPerson，參數則和預期

cues.en: expect, Mona.
cues.zh: 一樣，是 Mona。

cues.en: So here, I'm just building up a small little output message, so I don't need to put it into every single tool.
cues.zh: 所以我在這裡統一組合輸出訊息，不必到每個工具裡重複撰寫。

cues.en: And then I'm calling next to let the tool be called.
cues.zh: 然後呼叫 Next，讓真正的工具繼續執行。

cues.en: You can do the same for Ben.
cues.zh: 查詢 Ben 也是一樣。

cues.en: We will hit this, and our argument will instead be Ben down here.
cues.zh: 同樣會進到這裡，這次下面的參數就會變成 Ben。

cues.en: And finally, we can do it for John,
cues.zh: 最後也可以查 John，

cues.en: and see that his colour is red.
cues.zh: 看到他喜歡的顏色是紅色。

cues.en: So that is the best way of telling your system.
cues.zh: 這就是通知系統工具呼叫狀態的合適做法。

cues.en: Right now, we are doing consoles, but it could be to a lock that this and this tool was called with this and this information, instead of putting them into the tools
cues.zh: 目前輸出到主控台，也可以改寫到記錄裡，統一記下哪個工具、以哪些資訊被呼叫，而不必寫進工具

cues.en: themselves.
cues.zh: 本身。

cues.en: But we can do more than this in here.
cues.zh: 不過，在這裡還能做更多事。

cues.en: We can also manipulate and even refuse to call the tool.
cues.zh: 也能修改呼叫，甚至拒絕執行工具。

cues.en: So I just put in a bit of code here, and I will set a few breakpoints here.
cues.zh: 我先加上一些程式碼，並設幾個中斷點，

cues.en: We'll see in one second what these do.
cues.zh: 馬上看看它們有什麼作用。

cues.en: So we'll start up again, and we'll again ask for Mona's favourite colour.
cues.zh: 重新啟動，再問 Mona 最喜歡什麼顏色。

cues.en: And Mona is not involved in any of the new code I put in, so she can still go through without any problems.
cues.zh: Mona 不符合剛加的任何條件，所以仍然可以直接通過。

cues.en: If we take Ben, we actually have set up that if it's getPerson, and the argument
cues.zh: 如果問 Ben，我們設定了條件：工具是 getPerson，而且參數

cues.en: value is Ben, we want to change on the fly what's going on.
cues.zh: 值是 Ben 時，動態改變處理方式。

cues.en: So we will hard code here that his favourite colour is orange with a hint of black stripes, which is certainly not the real one, which was green.
cues.zh: 這裡直接指定他的最愛是「帶有黑色條紋的橘色」，這當然不是真實資料，原本是綠色。

cues.en: So we can on the fly change things here.
cues.zh: 所以可以在呼叫當下動態修改內容，

cues.en: We can just return what the tool should give back.
cues.zh: 直接回傳應該交給模型的工具結果。

cues.en: We can on the fly change some of the argument values and the names.
cues.zh: 也可以動態修改參數值或名稱。

cues.en: So you can inspect if things look slightly wrong, and you can on the fly change it.
cues.zh: 因此能先檢查資料是否有問題，再於當下調整。

cues.en: You can do that.
cues.zh: 這些都做得到。

cues.en: So you can essentially just intercept and change whatever you want in the tool code, because
cues.zh: 基本上可以攔截工具呼叫，並修改你想改的內容，因為

cues.en: if we do this, it now says, okay, we went a bit too long.
cues.zh: 執行之後；喔，這次在中斷點停得太久了。

cues.en: So now it comes back and says Ben's favourite colour is orange with a hint of black stripes.
cues.zh: 現在它回覆，Ben 最喜歡的是帶有黑色條紋的橘色。

cues.en: So before the internal timeout of the tool calling inside Agent Framework happened, and it said, oh, something must be wrong.
cues.zh: 剛才是 Agent Framework 內部的工具呼叫等候逾時，它認為可能出了問題，

cues.en: It didn't come back.
cues.zh: 因為工具遲遲沒有回傳。

cues.en: What happens if we ask about John's favourite colour?
cues.zh: 如果問 John 最喜歡什麼顏色呢？

cues.en: In this case, I put in that John's data is secret, so we can either throw back null, or we can throw back an
cues.zh: 這裡我設定 John 的資料是機密，因此可以回傳 null，或擲回一個

cues.en: exception.
cues.zh: 例外。

cues.en: And what we will see happen is that it says it can't get it.
cues.zh: 結果會看到它表示無法取得資料。

cues.en: And this was not because of the exception or the timeout.
cues.zh: 這次不是剛才的中斷點逾時造成的。

cues.en: We can try again to see what happens.
cues.zh: 可以再試一次，看看會發生什麼。

cues.en: What is John's favourite colour?
cues.zh: 「John 最喜歡什麼顏色？」

cues.en: You will often see it tries it twice.
cues.zh: 常常會看到它嘗試兩次。

cues.en: This is a retry mechanism inside the Agent Framework that it says, oh, something could have had a hiccup.
cues.zh: 這是 Agent Framework 內部的重試機制：它認為也許只是暫時發生問題，

cues.en: Let me do it twice.
cues.zh: 所以再做一次。

cues.en: But it won't be let through because I'm throwing the exception every time.
cues.zh: 但因為每次都擲出例外，所以始終無法通過。

cues.en: So this is how tool calling works.
cues.zh: 這就是工具呼叫中介軟體的運作方式。

cues.en: There are other tool middlewares that you add in the same manner, which we'll cover in later sessions.
cues.zh: 其他工具中介軟體也透過相同方式加入，後面章節會再介紹。

cues.en: Thank you.
cues.zh: 謝謝觀看。
